stem: Which of the following vasculitic conditions is considered a 'notable exception' because it is essentially limited to elderly populations and not seen in children?
explanation: The text explicitly states that children do not get giant cell arteritis as it is limited to the elderly.
rationale: Consider the age-related limitations mentioned for large vessel diseases.

optionExplanations.A: The source mentions that children, particularly adolescents, can indeed develop this condition which affects the aorta.
optionExplanations.B: The text explicitly states that children do not get giant cell arteritis as it is limited to the elderly.
optionExplanations.C: This medium-sized vessel disease is listed as one of the conditions that is seen in children.
optionExplanations.D: This is described as the most common vasculitis of childhood.

source.hint: Consider the age-related limitations mentioned for large vessel diseases.
